mathematical_proofs.name: W3C_SVG_Normalized_Diagonal_Percentage_Length_Conversion
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x013574..0x013584, s0 = length->value / 100.0f (mov w8, #0x42c80000). When type (w2) == 2 (SR_SVG_LENGTH_TYPE_OTHER), the jump table at .rodata 0x032e83 branches to 0x01366c: ldp s1, s2, [x1, #0x30] loads view_box.width and view_box.height, computes s1 = s1*s1 + s2*s2, widens to IEEE-754 double via fcvt d1, s1 (0x013684), computes fsqrt d1, d1 (0x013688), multiplies by d3 loaded from .rodata 0x032e68 (cd3b7f669ea0e63f = 1/sqrt(2) = 0.70710678118654757), narrows back via fcvt s1, d1 (0x013690), and returns fmul s0, s0, s1 (0x013694).

mathematical_proofs.name: Cubic_Bezier_Circle_Approximation_Kappa_Invariant
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x014e3c..0x014e68, add_circle_to_path loads d1 from .rodata 0x032e70 (80dc8bb249a9e13f = 0.55191502449351057), widens radius s9 to d0 (fcvt d0, s9), computes d13 = d0 * d1 (fmul d13, d0, d1), and constructs the cubic Bezier control coordinates cx +/- d13 and cy +/- d13 around (cx, cy, r).

mathematical_proofs.name: RGB_Percentage_Fixed_Point_Reciprocal_Division_by_100
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x01331c..0x013330, each percentage channel w8, w9, w11 is multiplied by 255 via (w << 8) - w. Then at 0x013334..0x013364, w11 is loaded with 0x51eb851f (mov w11, #0x851f; movk w11, #0x51eb, lsl #16, where ceil(2^37 / 100) = 1374389535 = 0x51eb851f), multiplied via umull x, w, w11, and shifted right by 37 bits (lsr #32 followed by lsl #11 & mask 0xffff0000 for Red, lsr #32 followed by lsl #3 & mask 0xffffff00 for Green, and lsr #37 for Blue).
